title: The Break-Even Parallel Speedup: When Multithreading Saves Energy for Edge CPU Inference
description: Public artifact for a manuscript under review. PMIC-measured campaigns on a Raspberry Pi 5 (Arm Cortex-A76) on when running DNN inference on more threads saves energy on an edge CPU. Energy at n threads relative to one obeys E_n / E_1 = (P_n / P_1) / S_n, so the empirical questions are how the speedup and the power ratio behave on real hardware and what is counted as power. The current analysis (data/v2/ and code/v2/) measures the static power floor at every operating point and reports the break-even condition both with the floor charged to the inference and without it; the earlier campaign is kept in data/ and code/. Includes raw per-run power and latency records and the analysis pipelines.
